description: Presencia de fibrocemento en regadíos is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Executive Council of the Spanish Geographical Information Infrastructure (CODIIGE). Identification and estimated inventory of irrigation ditches made of fibrocement or “uralite”, which contain asbestos. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Presence of fibrocement in irrigation" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Human health and safety, Dataset no público. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
